nodes.label: chainforge Python Package (Flask server + CLI)
nodes.rationale: Entry point chainforge = chainforge.app:main; chainforge serve runs flask_app.py on port 8000.

nodes.label: react-server React/TypeScript Frontend
nodes.rationale: Create React App via craco; almost all application logic lives here. npm start/build/test scripts are gated by prettier+eslint; bypass with npx craco start for fast iteration.

nodes.label: In-Browser TypeScript Backend (src/backend/)
nodes.rationale: Full TypeScript reimplementation of ChainForge's core that executes client-side: LLM querying, prompt templating/permutation, response caching, model registry, shared types. This is why craco.config.js polyfills Node built-ins (buffer, crypto, stream, http, net) - browser code calls APIs that assume Node.

nodes.label: Thin Flask Backend (flask_app.py)
nodes.rationale: Deliberately thin: serves the built React app and only covers work that genuinely needs a server - /app/executepy Python eval subprocess, example/OpenAI-eval flows, env API keys, custom providers, flow storage, media upload, CORS image proxy.

nodes.label: Pyodide In-Browser Python Evaluation
nodes.rationale: Alternative to the Flask /app/executepy route: Python evaluation can run fully in-browser via src/backend/pyodide/, removing the server dependency.

nodes.label: FLASK_BASE_URL Frontend-Flask Wiring
nodes.rationale: FLASK_BASE_URL is '/' when served by Flask (detected via injected window.__CF_PORT), otherwise defaults to http://localhost:8000/. During frontend dev on port 3000, server-dependent features require a parallel Flask instance on 8000; pure in-browser features work with the dev server alone.

nodes.label: ReactFlow Node Graph (src/*Node.tsx)
nodes.rationale: Each src/*Node.tsx is a ReactFlow node type registered in the nodeTypes map in App.tsx; nodes read upstream inputs via pullInputData and write outputs to node.data.fields. data.fields is only an array on prompt/chat nodes - guard with Array.isArray elsewhere.

nodes.label: Zustand Store (store.tsx)
nodes.rationale: Holds nodes, edges, and initLLMProviderMenu (the model list shown in the UI).

nodes.label: Duplicated Model Registry (models.ts + store.tsx)
nodes.rationale: Adding or changing a model touches two places that must stay in sync: the NativeLLM enum plus rate-limit/cost tables in src/backend/models.ts, and initLLMProviderMenu in store.tsx. base_model selects which settings form in ModelSettingSchemas.tsx and must be unique per settings schema.
